recognize_zh: 數顆漿細胞核偏位、細胞質淡藍色，細胞質內堆滿粗大、紅紫色的桿狀至圓形嗜天青顆粒，清楚呈現Snapper-Schneid顆粒。
features: Clustered plasma cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei and coarse chromatin
Pale blue cytoplasm filled with coarse reddish-purple, rod-like to round azurophilic granules
Granules densely packed in some cells and partly surrounding the nucleus
Occasional binucleate or lobulated plasmacytoid nucleus
Scattered free granules and a neutrophil in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, and pale blue cytoplasm. Many cells contain abundant coarse reddish-purple azurophilic granules, some rod-shaped, that fill much of the cytoplasm. Free granules are scattered in the background, and a segmented neutrophil is present. Findings are consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules in plasma cells, a feature described in plasma cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei, fine chromatin, Auer rods/faggot cells, and are CD138 negative/MPO strongly positive.
Mast cells have round central nuclei with dense purple-black metachromatic granules and express tryptase/CD117.
Crystal-storing cells show sharply angular needle- or rhomboid-shaped inclusions rather than numerous small azurophilic granules.
